column20: THE DASHBOARD DISPLAY WENT BLANK WHILE DRIVING AT HIGHWAY SPEED AND EVERY WARNING LAMP ILLUMINATED AT ONCE. THE DEALER COULD NOT REPRODUCE THE FAULT.
BRAKE PEDAL TRAVELLED TO THE FLOOR ON A WET DESCENT AND THE ANTILOCK LAMP STAYED ON UNTIL THE IGNITION WAS CYCLED.

column12: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:COOLING SYSTEM:RADIATOR ASSEMBLY
column20: COOLANT SPRAYED ONTO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD AND SMOKE ENTERED THE CABIN THROUGH THE VENTS WHILE STOPPED AT A LIGHT.
THE AIRBAG READINESS LAMP FLASHES A FOUR BLINK PATTERN EVERY MORNING AND CLEARS AFTER ABOUT TEN MINUTES OF DRIVING.
THE TRANSMISSION SHIFTS HARSHLY FROM SECOND TO THIRD AND OCCASIONALLY REFUSES TO ENGAGE REVERSE UNTIL THE ENGINE IS RESTARTED.
POWER STEERING ASSIST CUT OUT FOR ROUGHLY TWO SECONDS WHILE TURNING INTO A PARKING SPACE AND THE WHEEL BECAME VERY HEAVY.
BOTH LOW BEAM PROJECTORS DIM TO ABOUT HALF OUTPUT AFTER TWENTY MINUTES AND RETURN TO NORMAL ONLY AFTER THE CAR HAS COOLED.
THE LOWER CONTROL ARM BUSHING SEPARATED AND THE VEHICLE PULLED SHARPLY RIGHT BEFORE CONTACTING A GUARDRAIL.
THE ENGINE STALLS WITHOUT WARNING BELOW A QUARTER TANK AND RESTARTS ONLY AFTER SEVERAL MINUTES OF CRANKING.
THE WIPERS PARK IN THE MIDDLE OF THE WINDSHIELD AND OBSTRUCT THE DRIVER VIEW UNTIL THE FUSE IS PULLED.
THE REAR PASSENGER DOOR LATCH RELEASES OVER SPEED BUMPS AND THE DOOR AJAR CHIME SOUNDS CONTINUOUSLY.
THE DRIVER SEAT BELT BUCKLE RELEASES UNDER MODERATE LOAD AND HAS TO BE RESEATED SEVERAL TIMES PER TRIP.
THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL STICKS AT LIGHT THROTTLE AND THE VEHICLE SURGES FORWARD WHEN THE PEDAL FINALLY RELEASES.
SMOKE ROSE FROM THE BATTERY COMPARTMENT DURING CHARGING AND THE VEHICLE REFUSED TO POWER UP AFTERWARDS.
AN INTERMITTENT RATTLE FROM UNDER THE FLOOR PAN GETS LOUDER WITH SPEED AND NO TECHNICIAN HAS LOCATED THE SOURCE.
A LOUD CLUNK COMES FROM THE DRIVELINE ON TAKE OFF AND A VIBRATION BUILDS BETWEEN FIFTY AND SIXTY MILES PER HOUR.
THE SIDE CURTAIN AIRBAG DEPLOYED WITHOUT ANY IMPACT WHILE THE VEHICLE WAS PARKED AND UNOCCUPIED.
THE WIRING HARNESS BEHIND THE LEFT KICK PANEL CHAFED THROUGH AND CAUSED RANDOM LOSS OF THE INSTRUMENT CLUSTER.
THE FRONT ROTORS WARPED WITHIN TEN THOUSAND MILES AND THE STEERING WHEEL SHAKES VIOLENTLY UNDER BRAKING FROM HIGHWAY SPEED.
THE AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKING ENGAGED HARD ON AN EMPTY ROAD WITH NO OBSTACLE PRESENT AND THE CAR CAME TO A FULL STOP.
THE ENGINE CONSUMES A QUART OF OIL EVERY EIGHT HUNDRED MILES AND THE LOW OIL LAMP GIVES NO ADVANCE WARNING.
THE HOOD RELEASED AT SPEED AND STRUCK THE WINDSCREEN AFTER THE SECONDARY LATCH FAILED TO HOLD.
THE REAR QUARTER GLASS SHATTERED SPONTANEOUSLY IN COLD WEATHER WITH THE VEHICLE PARKED OVERNIGHT.
THE DRIVER SEAT SLID REARWARD DURING ACCELERATION BECAUSE THE POWER TRACK MOTOR DISENGAGED FROM ITS RAIL.
THE TYRE PLACARD ON THE DOOR JAMB LISTS A PRESSURE THAT DOES NOT MATCH THE OWNER MANUAL FOR THE FITTED WHEEL SIZE.
BOTH TAIL LIGHT CLUSTERS FILL WITH CONDENSATION AFTER RAIN AND THE BULBS FAIL WITHIN A FEW WEEKS.
THE STABILITY CONTROL INTERVENED ON DRY PAVEMENT AND CUT ENGINE POWER FOR SEVERAL SECONDS WHILE MERGING.
THE OUTER TIE ROD END SEPARATED AT LOW SPEED AND THE VEHICLE LEFT THE ROADWAY AND STRUCK A TREE.
DIESEL SEEPS FROM AN INJECTOR RETURN LINE AND POOLS ON THE CYLINDER HEAD WHERE IT BAKES AND SMOKES.
THE REVERSING CAMERA SHOWS A FROZEN IMAGE FROM THE PREVIOUS MANOEUVRE INSTEAD OF THE LIVE VIEW BEHIND THE VEHICLE.
